;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2019 Turkish offensive into north-eastern Syria]], [[Second Northern Syria Buffer Zone]] 
**[[Vladimir Putin]] and [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]], presidents of [[Russia]] and [[Turkey]] respectively, [[Second Northern Syria Buffer Zone|reach an agreement]] in [[Sochi]], which would end Turkey's offensive into Northern Syria. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/10/22/middleeast/putin-erdogan-syria-deal-hodge-analysis-intl/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.cnn.com/middleeast/live-news/turkey-syria-10-22-2019/index.html (CNN<sub>2</sub>)]

;Arts and culture
*[[2019 Japanese imperial transition]]
**[[Japan]]ese Emperor [[Naruhito]] officially proclaims his [[Enthronement of the Japanese emperor|enthronement]] as the [[Emperor of Japan]] in an ancient enthronement ceremony held in the [[Tokyo Imperial Palace|Imperial Palace]] in [[Tokyo]], after ascending to the throne on 1 May. It was attended by about 2,000 guests with 420 foreign dignitaries. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/10/21/asia/japan-enthronement-emperor-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-50120563 (BBC News)]
*[[First presidency of Donald Trump|Presidency of Donald Trump]]
**An anonymous senior [[First presidency of Donald Trump|Donald Trump]] administration official, who in 2018 wrote a [[I Am Part of the Resistance Inside the Trump Administration|controversial]] [[The New York Times|New York Times]] [[op-ed]] called treasonous by President Trump, has written a book about the administration titled [[A Warning (book)|"A Warning,"]] its publisher says. It will be released next month. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/anonymous-author-of-trump-resistance-op-ed-to-publish-a-tell-all-book/2019/10/22/b9ea2f42-f45a-11e9-ad8b-85e2aa00b5ce_story.html?fbclid=IwAR13nxOeNL47UJ0LeDCytXhsEm6Gq9kgbWkAgf4OKthDx_BdqtpGpMhxIrA (''The Washington Post'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Florida International University pedestrian bridge collapse]]
**The [[National Transportation Safety Board]] of the [[United States]] concludes its investigation into the accident, which killed six and injured ten. It states design errors were the immediate cause, exacerbated by failures to take appropriate remedial action when cracks were discovered. [https://eu.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2019/10/22/design-error-blamed-florida-international-university-pedestrian-bridge-collapse/2449316001/ (''USA Today'')]
*A convention centre [[2019 SkyCity Convention Centre Fire|catches fire]] in Auckland while still under construction, causing significant disruption in the [[Auckland CBD|CBD]]. [https://www.stuff.co.nz/national/116480357/fire-at-sky-city-convention-centre (Stuff)]

;Law and crime
*[[Crime in Norway]]
**[[Oslo Police District|Police officers]] in [[Oslo]] wound an armed 32-year-old man, who injured three people when he [[Vehicle-ramming attack|rammed]] a stolen ambulance into them. The police then arrest him and a 25-year-old woman, both of whom have connections to the [[Nordic Resistance Movement]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/oct/22/injured-man-ambulance-oslo (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2019/10/22/armed-man-steals-ambulance-drives-crowds-oslo/ (''The Telegraph'')]
*[[Manchester Arena bombing]]
**[[United Kingdom|UK]] [[Home Secretary]] [[Priti Patel]] announces the [[inquest]]s into the deaths of the victims will be converted into a [[public inquiry]] at the request of the coroner. This enables the hearing of evidence in secret by members of the intelligence community, which would otherwise not be available as the coroner had previously granted [[public interest immunity]] to the witnesses on the grounds of possible assistance to future terrorists were the evidence to be heard. Inquests cannot hear secret evidence. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2019/10/22/public-inquiry-held-manchester-terror-attack-allow-security/ (''The Telegraph'')]
*[[2019 Trump–Ukraine scandal]], [[Impeachment inquiry into Donald Trump]]
**Acting [[List of ambassadors of the United States to Ukraine|U.S. Ambassador to Ukraine]] [[William B. Taylor Jr.]] testifies before [[United States Congress|Congress]] that he had been told [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]] would, to help his reelection chances, withhold military aid to [[Ukraine]] until that country publicly declared investigations would be launched into [[Burisma Holdings]], a company that hired former [[Vice President of the United States|Vice President]] [[Joe Biden]]'s son [[Hunter Biden|Hunter]], as well as Ukraine's alleged involvement in the [[2016 United States presidential election|2016 U.S. presidential election]]. [https://www.salon.com/2019/10/22/trumps-ukraine-envoy-gives-congress-most-damning-evidence-yet-in-impeachment-probe/?fbclid=IwAR2x241HcpidjYTOLbyhc9lcj7EuiBo7koy5qKCIYefN2NGiUzP8ZxdzUjI (''Salon'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Chilean protests]]
**According to candidate for [[Vice President of Argentina]] for the [[Juntos por el Cambio|Together for Change]] alliance, [[Miguel Ángel Pichetto]], there is a "destabilization plan in [[Latin America]] directly linked to [[Venezuela]]'s and [[Cuba]]'s governments' activities". [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Worship|Argentine Foreign Minister]] [[Jorge Faurie]] also expressed his concerns and said there were "calculated and identical methods of destabilization in the region". He blames [[Nicolás Maduro]]'s government after [[2017 Constituent National Assembly|Constituent Assembly]] President [[Diosdado Cabello]] says there is a "[[Bolivarian]] breeze" in the region.  [https://www.clarin.com/politica/jorge-faurie-cree-protestas-region-accionar-coordinado-metodos-calcados-_0_YyR6TF-k.html (''Clarín'')] [https://www.batimes.com.ar/news/argentina/jorge-faurie-latin-america-threatened-by-bolivarian-hurricane.phtml?fbclid=IwAR2GmCyI2rZp0gcB0Yqe0Arn-KORFN1oJy2rCHS9FZZmlhWC0Ghm5yhnUAA (''Buenos Aires Times'')]
*[[Abortion in Northern Ireland]], [[Same-sex marriage in Northern Ireland]]
**As a result of the [[Northern Ireland Executive|local government]] failing to reconvene in time, the [[Northern Ireland (Executive Formation etc) Act 2019]] comes into effect. This means [[abortion]] is decriminalized in [[Northern Ireland]], and [[same-sex marriage]] is scheduled to commence in February 2020. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-northern-ireland-50128860 (BBC News)]
*[[Brexit]]
**The [[Parliament of the United Kingdom|British Parliament]] votes 329 to 299 to pass the Withdrawal Agreement Bill, but then rejects the proposed timetable in a separate 322 to 308 vote. [[Speaker of the House of Commons (United Kingdom)|Speaker of the House of Commons]] [[John Bercow]] says the bill is now "in limbo", and [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|Prime Minister]] [[Boris Johnson]] plans to consult with [[European Union]] leaders for the time being. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-50146182 (BBC News)]
